summary: Cabin lookout built 1962 on Mount Hamell near Grande Cache, per Alberta Wildfire's layer; active, with no source describing public visits.

access.note: Active Alberta Wildfire site; the layer lists access mode as fly. No source found says the public may visit.

events.note: Cabin; year of construction per the Alberta Wildfire lookout layer

evidence.supports: location on Mount Hamell near Grande Cache
evidence.quote: Mount Hamell is a challenging and rewarding backcountry trail near Grande Cache

evidence.supports: fire lookout near the summit of Mount Hamell
evidence.quote: with the trail eventually reaching the fire lookout near the summit

evidence.supports: trail listing asks people on the trail to respect the privacy of whoever is on duty at the fire lookout
evidence.quote: Please be mindful of the on-duty fire lookout's privacy.

evidence.supports: each site staffed by an observer, generally April to October
evidence.quote: Each site is staffed by a lookout observer whose job is to watch for wildfire all day, each day, generally from April to October.

sources.title: Alberta Wildfire: Wildfire Lookouts of Alberta (WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT) layer query
sources.publisher: Government of Alberta, FireSmart vector data service

notes_for_editor: Only the build year (1962), cabin type and elevation come from the provincial layer; no history of staffing, fires, rebuilds or the cabin's condition was found. The layer gives TOWER_HEIGHT 2.0 for this cabin, which is probably not a tower height, so height_m is not carried into facts; the existing record's height_m of 2.0 may warrant clearing. The access level 'closed' is carried from the existing record. The onX trail-map page is a commercial trail guide used only for location and a visitor caveat. An AllTrails listing for the same lookout returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Corrections: none.
